chain_focus: AI security and trusted compute: the silicon, appliances and services that protect AI models, data and infrastructure. Security silicon (TPMs, platform roots of trust, root-of-trust FPGAs, OpenTitan / Caliptra RoT and the IP behind them), hardware security modules inside hyperscale clouds, confidential computing on GPUs and CPUs (NVIDIA Confidential Computing, AMD SEV-SNP, Intel TDX) and the confidential-AI software built on it, through server makers, hyperscalers and neoclouds, up to cybersecurity platforms that are themselves consumers of AI compute (CrowdStrike, Palo Alto Networks, Cloudflare, Akamai).
